findings.oracle: Real Win32 relaunch builder driven through frozen/pixi/plain/missing-pixi/empty launch modes via genuine sys.frozen + sys.executable + PIXI_* env state; each test now asserts the exact executable (== str(binary) for frozen, == str(pixi_exe) for pixi, == sys.executable otherwise) AND the full hand-verified literal ShellExecuteW parameter string including ELEVATED_FLAG and original-arg order (e.g. 'run --manifest-path <m> --environment default python -m intellicrack --gui --project demo --elevated'), replacing the prior weak Path(executable).is_file() check.
